question: Why did deliberate not improve benchmark performance, given the loop works and uptake is real?
method: Read all 18 best-pilot trajectories end to end, deliberation checkpoint texts, verifier outputs, and branch latency distributions. No sampling, no skimming.

1_checkpoint_content_is_generic.evidence: rp-glm53-flash query checkpoints advise inspect schema, check sqlite version, write and test identical output. The agent was already doing all three. No checkpoint names an index, a join order, a cardinality fact, or any query-specific insight.
1_checkpoint_content_is_generic.mechanism: Branches see only the trajectory; early trajectories contain no evidence, so four strong models restate the workflow. The reducer faithfully summarizes generic continuations into a generic checkpoint. Evidence-in, evidence-out.
1_checkpoint_content_is_generic.why_deliberate_did_not_help: The checkpoint added zero information beyond the agent's own next step.

2_query_fails_on_deliverable_discipline_.evidence: rp AND ctl flash-query both fail 4 subtests identically with Solution SQL not found at /app/sol.sql; correctness subtests passed. rp ended with true after EXPLAIN (never wrote sol.sql); ctl wrote sol.sql then deleted it with rm -f. The lone pass (noop flash query, 6/6) spent its tail byte-comparing candidates, writing sol.sql, timing the FINAL file, and checking statement count.
2_query_fails_on_deliverable_discipline_.mechanism: The differentiator is convergence plus file discipline under time pressure, not reasoning depth. Deliberation never mentions deliverable state.
2_query_fails_on_deliverable_discipline_.why_deliberate_did_not_help: No checkpoint tracks acceptance criteria (sol.sql must exist, single statement, small). The branch shim asks for diagnosis and next actions but nothing about task requirements, and branches cannot see the verifier.

3_deliberation_roughly_doubles_per_turn_.evidence: Branch p50 6-30s across rosters; each deliberation adds a controller round plus fan-out plus reduce. Directed Nemotron trials deliberated nearly every turn (10-13 deliberations over 24 requests) with proxy wall 889s of a 900s cap. Best-pilot rp trials deliberated less and finished inside the cap with identical rewards to ctl.
3_deliberation_roughly_doubles_per_turn_.mechanism: Every deliberation buys extra cognition at the price of an entire extra model round-trip cycle, displacing acting turns one-for-one under a fixed cap.
3_deliberation_roughly_doubles_per_turn_.why_deliberate_did_not_help: On passing tasks the extra cognition was unnecessary (everything passes); on hard tasks the displaced acting turns were the binding constraint.

4_log_summary_proves_overhead_without_ga.evidence: ctl log 4.7m pass, noop log 4.4m pass, rp log 16.5m pass with 8 deliberations of which 7 degraded (Super reducer 500/503s). Same reward, 3.5x wall time.
4_log_summary_proves_overhead_without_ga.mechanism: When the task is within the model's direct reach, deliberation is pure overhead and an additional failure surface (reducer flakiness).
4_log_summary_proves_overhead_without_ga.why_deliberate_did_not_help: Nothing to gain; only latency and flakiness to add.

5_noop_sweep_shows_prompt_beats_ensemble.evidence: noop 5/6 overall with the only query-optimize pass anywhere; rp 4/6, ctl 4/6. The directive instruction plus neutral acknowledgment coincides with the best results; the 4-model ensemble adds nothing measurable on top.
5_noop_sweep_shows_prompt_beats_ensemble.mechanism: Being told to think-then-act changes behavior (converge, verify, mind the deliverable); the branch continuations add no further signal beyond that.
5_noop_sweep_shows_prompt_beats_ensemble.why_deliberate_did_not_help: The effective ingredient may be the instruction, not the ensemble.

what_might_have_helped: Checkpoints grounded in acceptance criteria: surface the task's verifier requirements (deliverable path, shape constraints) in the branch context, so deliberation tracks what actually scores.
Time-awareness: branches currently cannot see wall-clock or budget pressure; a turn that says deliberate-more vs converge-now cannot be chosen well without it.

Selective invocation: deliberating nearly every turn maximizes cost; the value is concentrated at stuck points (failed attempts, conflicting evidence), which the v2 prompt already named but the directive overrode.

Diverse roles over diverse models: all measured ensembles used the same-agent shim; the built-but-unused challenger/alternative/evidence roles directly target the generic-consensus failure observed here.
Reducer reliability: Super 500/503s under load; Mercury swap pilot tests exactly this.
